triage#1 · os-warren · session_01JQwxbZKP5YM48rWMWTS7wE

Triage: lands in `area:ux` · `domain:ui` · `priority:p2` · Bug · `pm:blocked` (Blocked-by: #36925) · size S.
Rationale: two headings on one board name the same record differently. That is a consistency defect on a view people use often, but it only shows when the target object's `nameField` differs from its default title, so the UX rule gives p2. It is blocked because the swimlane title it corrects arrives with PR #36925. The unlock scan moves it to `pm:queue` when #36925 merges. Seat 3 takes it, as its request said.
